title: @dskripchenko/flow monitoring snapshot
description: What a monitoring endpoint returns for the graph on screen. Every field is optional; ids refer to the graph's nodes and edges.

status.description: active, done, error, waiting, skipped, or a host status (drawn neutral unless mapped by statusTones).

count.description: Instances in or through the node.

badge.description: A short corner badge, e.g. an error count.

path.description: The current instance's node ids in visiting order.

current.description: Nodes the current instance is in now.

updatedAt.description: When the host produced the snapshot.
